title: John Leguizamo Has a Message for David Ellison: ‘Think of What Americans Need and What the Industry Needs’
content:
ByMarc Malkin

Senior Editor, Culture and Events

John Leguizamois speaking out about the Paramount and Warner Bros. merger, and he’s imploring David Ellison to consider what the industry needs as he takes over the new Skydance.

“Come on, Dave. Do the right thing. Don’t just think of yourself and your pocket. Think of what Americans need and what the industry needs. Think of others for a change.”

John Leguizamo has a message for Skydance chief David Ellison:“C’mon, Dave. Do the right thing. Don’t just think of yourself and your pocket. Think of what Americans and the industry needs. Think of others for a change.”pic.twitter.com/DjEUzXvWja

Althoughthe terms of the mergerinclude Paramount-WBD being prohibited from selling the Paramount Studios or Warner Bros. lots in California for at least five years. Leguizamo said “that’s still not enough.”

“You got an end date. You got an expiration date. That’s not cool,” he said. “People have to plan for the rest of their lives. They plan for five years, and then what?”

“…The industry belongs in L.A.,” Leguizamo said Friday at the Critics Choice Association’s 6th Annual Celebración of Cinema & Television, where he was honored with the Career Achievement Award. “We need to support it and grow it. Rebuild it and add to it. Not subtract.”

John Leguizamo says it’s “despicable” and “heartless” that David Ellison’s Skydance is threatening to move Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery’s film and TV production out of Los Angeles.When Variety’s@marcmalkinbrought up the five-year production commitment in Ellison’s…pic.twitter.com/yj2YwtwAcG

In April, Leguizamo was one of more than 4,000 film and TV stars and creatives who signed an open letter opposing Paramount Skydance’s pending acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery.

“We are deeply concerned by indications of support for this merger that prioritize the interests of a small group of powerful stakeholders over the broader public good,” said the letter, which was published by the New York Times and available on the website BlocktheMerger.com. “The integrity, independence, and diversity of our industry would be grievously compromised. Competition is essential for a healthy economy and a healthy democracy. So is thoughtful regulation and enforcement.”

Other signatories included Joaquin Phoenix, Ben Stiller, Kristen Stewart, Robert De Niro, Sofia Coppola, Florence Pugh, Pedro Pascal, Edward Norton, Atsuko Okatsuka, Adam McKay, Alan Cumming, Alyssa Milano, Boots Riley, Bryan Cranston, Cynthia Nixon, Damon Lindelof, David Fincher, Denis Villeneuve, Elliot Page, Glenn Close, Jane Fonda, JJ Abrams, Jason Bateman, John Leguizamo, Lin-Manuel Miranda, Margaret Cho, Mark Ruffalo, Noah Wyle, Patti Lupone, Ramy Youssef, Rosario Dawson, Rosie O’Donnell, Ted Danson, Tiffany Haddish, Tig Notaro, Yorgos Lanthimos and Yvette Nicole Brown.

Leguizamo also talked about receiving the Career Achievement Award. “It means they five that to you when you think your career is over,” he cracked, before continuing, “I’ve been in it for four decades, a long time, a lot of sacrifices, a lot of great things, a lot of pain and it feels like, ‘Oh, wow. It was worth for something. People notice and recognize what you’ve done and contributed to cinema.’”

John Leguizamo calls “Mission: Impossible — Reckoning” a “bomb so expensive they teach it in business school.”via The Critics Choice Association's 6th Annual Celebración Of Cinema & Televisionpic.twitter.com/Z7NLXqG8sW

He delivered emotional remarks while accepting the award from director Gregory Nava. “I will not be finished until every Latin child in this country can turn on a screen,” he said, tearing up. “When a Latin child in this country can turn on a screen and see their own face, their own name, their grandma’s accent, not getting arrested, not dying in minute nine [of an action movie], just living, just being a whole person, that’s the dream. It’s an embarrassingly small one, but they’ve made us fight over it for over a hundred years. So keep creating. Keep failing forward and don’t’ let anyone every quiet your voice, including the one inside your head telling you that you’re not good enough. That voice is a fucking liar and it doesn’t know what the hell it’s talking about.”

Honorees also included Aimee Carrero (Supporting Actress Award – Series; “Your Friends & Neighbors”), Beth de Araújo (Breakthrough Director Award; “Josephine”), Inde Navarrette (Breakthrough Actress Award – Film; “Obsession”), James Ortiz (Innovator Award; “Project Hail Mary”), Javier Calvo & Javier Ambrossi, popularly known as “Los Javis” (Director Award; “La Bola Negra”), Judy Reyes (Trailblazer Award; “High Potential”), Laysla De Oliveira (Breakthrough Actress Award – Series; “Lioness”), Oscar Nuñez (Vanguard Award; “The Paper”), Peter Dager (Rising Star Award; “Stick”) and Rodrigo Teixeira (Producer Award; “Paper Tiger”).
title_zh: 約翰·雷吉扎莫(John Leguizamo)對大衛·艾利森(David Ellison)發出了一個訊息：「想想美國人需要什麼以及產業需要什麼。」
content_zh:
由馬克·馬爾金(Marc Malkin)報導

高級編輯，文化與活動

約翰·雷吉薩莫(John Leguizamo)對派拉蒙(Paramount)和華納兄弟(Warner Bros.)的合併發表了看法，他呼籲大衛·艾利森(David Ellison)在接管新的Skydance時考慮行業的需求。

“來吧，戴夫。做正確的事。不要只想到自己和你的口袋。想想美國人需要什麼，行業需要什麼。換個角度想想別人。”

約翰·雷吉薩莫對Skydance的負責人大衛·艾利森說：“來吧，戴夫。做正確的事。不要只想到自己和你的口袋。想想美國人和行業需要什麼。換個角度想想別人。” 

儘管合併的條款包括派拉蒙-WBD在至少五年內禁止出售派拉蒙影業或華納兄弟的加州影棚，雷吉薩莫表示“這仍然不夠。”

“你有一個結束日期。你有一個到期日。這樣不行，”他說。“人們必須為他們的餘生做計劃。他們計劃五年，那麼接下來呢？”

“……這個行業屬於洛杉磯，”雷吉薩莫在第六屆影評人選擇協會(Critics Choice Association)的電影與電視慶祝活動上說，他在該活動中獲得了職業成就獎。“我們需要支持它並發展它。重建它並增加內容，而不是減少。”

約翰·雷吉薩莫表示，大衛·艾利森的Skydance威脅將派拉蒙和華納兄弟探索的電影和電視製作搬出洛杉磯是“可惡的”和“無情的”。當《綜藝》(Variety)的馬克·馬爾金提到艾利森的五年製作承諾時……

在四月，雷吉薩莫是超過4,000名電影和電視明星及創意工作者之一，他們簽署了一封公開信，反對派拉蒙Skydance即將收購華納兄弟探索的計劃。

“我們對這項合併的支持表現深感擔憂，因為它將少數強大利益相關者的利益置於更廣泛的公共利益之上，”該信函中寫道，該信函由《紐約時報》發表，並可在網站BlocktheMerger.com上找到。“我們行業的完整性、獨立性和多樣性將受到嚴重損害。競爭對於健康的經濟和健康的民主至關重要。深思熟慮的監管和執法也是如此。”

其他簽署者包括華金·菲尼克斯(Joaquin Phoenix)、本·斯蒂勒(Ben Stiller)、克里斯汀·史都華(Kristen Stewart)、羅伯特·德尼羅(Robert De Niro)、索非亞·科波拉(Sofia Coppola)、佛羅倫斯·皮尤(Florence Pugh)、佩德羅·帕斯卡(Pedro Pascal)、愛德華·諾頓(Edward Norton)、岡崎厚子(Atsuko Okatsuka)、亞當·麥凱(Adam McKay)、艾倫·卡明(Alan Cumming)、艾莉莎·米蘭諾(Alyssa Milano)、布茲·萊利(Boots Riley)、布萊恩·克蘭斯頓(Bryan Cranston)、辛西婭·尼克森(Cynthia Nixon)、達蒙·林德洛夫(Damon Lindelof)、大衛·芬奇(David Fincher)、丹尼斯·維倫紐瓦(Denis Villeneuve)、艾略特·佩奇(Elliot Page)、格倫·克洛斯(Glenn Close)、簡·方達(Jane Fonda)、J.J.艾布拉姆斯(JJ Abrams)、傑森·貝特曼(Jason Bateman)、約翰·雷吉薩莫(John Leguizamo)、林-曼努爾·米蘭達(Lin-Manuel Miranda)、瑪格·周(Margaret Cho)、馬克·魯法洛(Mark Ruffalo)、諾亞·懷爾(Noah Wyle)、帕蒂·盧波(Patti Lupone)、拉米·尤瑟夫(Ramy Youssef)、羅莎里奧·道森(Rosario Dawson)、羅西·奧唐奈(Rosie O’Donnell)、泰德·丹森(Ted Danson)、蒂法尼·哈迪許(Tiffany Haddish)、提格·諾塔羅(Tig Notaro)、喬治·蘭西莫斯(Yorgos Lanthimos)和伊薇特·尼科爾·布朗(Yvette Nicole Brown)。

約翰·雷吉薩莫(John Leguizamo)也談到了獲得職業成就獎的感受。他說：“這意味著當你認為自己的職業生涯已經結束時，他們卻給你這個獎。”他開玩笑道，接著說：“我已經在這行四十年了，這是一段漫長的時間，做了很多犧牲，經歷了許多美好的事情，也有很多痛苦，感覺就像是，‘哦，哇，這一切是有價值的。人們注意到並認可你在電影界所做的貢獻。’”

約翰·雷吉薩莫(John Leguizamo)稱《不可能的任務：清算》(Mission: Impossible — Reckoning)是一部“如此昂貴的炸彈，以至於商學院會教這部電影。”

他在接受導演格雷戈里·納瓦(Gregory Nava)頒發的獎項時發表了感人的講話。他淚眼汪汪地說：“直到這個國家的每一個拉丁裔孩子都能打開螢幕，我才不會停止。”他接著說：“當這個國家的拉丁裔孩子能夠打開螢幕，看到自己的面孔、自己的名字、祖母的口音，而不是被逮捕，不是在動作片的第九分鐘死去，而是活著，成為一個完整的人，那就是夢想。這是一個令人尷尬的小夢想，但他們讓我們為此奮鬥了超過一百年。所以繼續創作。繼續向前失敗，不要讓任何人壓制你的聲音，包括你心中告訴你不夠好的那個聲音。那個聲音是個該死的騙子，它根本不知道自己在說什麼。”

獲獎者還包括艾美·卡雷羅(Aimee Carrero)（系列最佳女配角獎；《你的朋友與鄰居》(Your Friends & Neighbors)）、貝絲·德·阿拉胡(Beth de Araújo)（突破導演獎；《約瑟芬》(Josephine)）、印德·納瓦雷特(Inde Navarrette)（突破女演員獎 – 電影；《迷戀》(Obsession)）、詹姆斯·奧爾蒂斯(James Ortiz)（創新獎；《海瑪利計畫》(Project Hail Mary)）、哈維爾·卡爾沃(Javier Calvo)和哈維爾·安布羅西(Javier Ambrossi)，通稱“洛斯·哈維斯”(Los Javis)（導演獎；《黑球》(La Bola Negra)）、朱迪·雷耶斯(Judy Reyes)（開拓者獎；《高潛力》(High Potential)）、萊斯拉·德·奧利維拉(Laysla De Oliveira)（突破女演員獎 – 系列；《獅子女》(Lioness)）、奧斯卡·努涅斯(Oscar Nuñez)（先鋒獎；《紙》(The Paper)）、彼得·達格(Peter Dager)（新星獎；《棍子》(Stick)）和羅德里戈·泰謝拉(Rodrigo Teixeira)（製作人獎；《紙虎》(Paper Tiger)）。
